causal_evidence.real_headroom_deficit: Six CI/local samples clustered near 1950-1957 ms and the balanced before protocol reached 2010 ms.
causal_evidence.css: The home waited on styles.css, its serial styles-tokens.css import, and home-10x.css; Lighthouse estimated 150-500 ms LCP savings.
causal_evidence.javascript: The frozen deferred app bundle produced long tasks near the simulated LCP boundary; delaying execution until after one paint reduced the common mode.
causal_evidence.external_variance: The CI outlier delayed all post-document requests by about 225 ms and attributed about 1002 ms to Unattributable work with loopback TTFB below 8 ms.
causal_evidence.font: Archivo was preloaded, font-display swap passed, and no font audit finding existed; the safe Latin-1 subset saved only 3136 bytes.
causal_evidence.edge: Cloudflare/Netcup and Netlify showed cold TTFB outliers, but CI used a loopback server, so edge behavior did not cause the required-check failure.
causal_evidence.harness: No selective retry, cache carry-over, path bypass, or reproducible methodological defect was found.

rejected_experiments.reason: Touched frozen shared CSS and did not improve worst-case LCP; reverted.
